notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Cacophodon has power equal to 1 or 2.
Siegehorn Ceratops' toughness is at least one greater than Cacophodon's power.
You have a way to give Cacophodon indestructible.
description:
Give Cacophodon indestructible, if needed.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Siegehorn Ceratops and Cacophodon to fight each other.
Siegehorn Ceratops and Cacophodon trigger twice.
Resolve both Siegehorn Ceratops trigger, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping Wayta and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat from step 2.
